1: // Orbit Dodge game
2: // Canvas element with id="game" must exist in the HTML.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) {
7:     console.error('Canvas with id "game" not found');
8:     return;
9:   }
10:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
11:   // Audio setup
12:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
13:   function playSound(freq, duration) {
14:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
15:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
16:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
17:     osc.type = 'sine';
18:     osc.connect(gain);
19:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
20:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime);
21:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.01);
22:     osc.start();
23:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
24:   }
25:   // Set canvas size to fill its container
26:   const resize = () => {
27:     canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth;
28:     canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight;
29:     // Recalculate centre and orbit radius
30:     centre = { x: canvas.width / 2, y: canvas.height / 2 };
31:     orbitRadius = Math.min(canvas.width, canvas.height) * 0.35;
32:   };
33:   window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
34:   resize();
35:   // generate starfield for background
36:   const starCount = 100;
37:   const stars = [];
38:   for (let i = 0; i < starCount; i++) {
39:     stars.push({
40:       x: Math.random() * canvas.width,
41:       y: Math.random() * canvas.height,
42:       radius: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,
43:     });
44:   }
45: 
46:   // Game state
47:   let centre = { x: canvas.width / 2, y: canvas.height / 2 };
48:   let orbitRadius = Math.min(canvas.width, canvas.height) * 0.35;
49:   const satellite = {
50:     angle: 0, // radians
51:     angularSpeed: 0.0015, // rad per ms
52:     radius: 12,
53:     color: '#00ffcc',
54:   };
55:   const debris = [];
56:   const debrisConfig = {
57:     minSpeed: 0.05,
58:     maxSpeed: 0.25,
59:     radius: 8,
60:     spawnInterval: 800, // ms
61:     lastSpawn: 0,
62:   };
63:   let startTime = null;
64:   let score = 0;
65:   let running = true;
66: 
67:   // Input handling – arrow left/right change angle, up/down change speed
68:   const keys = {};
69:   window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
70:     // resume audio context on user interaction
71:     if (audioCtx.state !== 'running') audioCtx.resume();
72:     keys[e.key] = true;
73:   });
74:   window.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => {
75:     keys[e.key] = false;
76:   });
77: 
78:   function spawnDebris(timestamp) {
79:     if (timestamp - debrisConfig.lastSpawn < debrisConfig.spawnInterval) return;
80:     debrisConfig.lastSpawn = timestamp;
81:     const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
82:     const speed = debrisConfig.minSpeed + Math.random() * (debrisConfig.maxSpeed - debrisConfig.minSpeed);
83:     // start at edge of canvas along the angle direction
84:     const startDist = Math.max(canvas.width, canvas.height);
85:     debris.push({
86:       angle,
87:       distance: startDist,
88:       speed,
89:     });
90:     // sound for new debris
91:     playSound(300, 0.08);
92:   }
93: 
94:   function update(delta) {
95:     // satellite controls
96:     if (keys.ArrowLeft) satellite.angle -= satellite.angularSpeed * delta;
97:     if (keys.ArrowRight) satellite.angle += satellite.angularSpeed * delta;
98:     if (keys.ArrowUp) satellite.angularSpeed *= 1.02; // accelerate
99:     if (keys.ArrowDown) satellite.angularSpeed *= 0.98; // decelerate
100: 
101:     // update debris positions
102:     for (let i = debris.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
103:       const d = debris[i];
104:       d.distance -= d.speed * delta;
105:       if (d.distance < 0) {
106:         debris.splice(i, 1);
107:         continue;
108:       }
109:       // collision detection
110:       const satX = centre.x + Math.cos(satellite.angle) * orbitRadius;
111:       const satY = centre.y + Math.sin(satellite.angle) * orbitRadius;
112:       const debrisX = centre.x + Math.cos(d.angle) * d.distance;
113:       const debrisY = centre.y + Math.sin(d.angle) * d.distance;
114:       const dx = satX - debrisX;
115:       const dy = satY - debrisY;
116:       const distSq = dx * dx + dy * dy;
117:       const radSum = satellite.radius + debrisConfig.radius;
118:       if (distSq < radSum * radSum) {
119:         running = false;
120:         // collision sound
121:         playSound(100, 0.3);
122:         break;
123:       }
124:     }
125:   }
126: 
127:   function draw() {
128:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
129:   // draw starfield
130:   ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
131:   for (const s of stars) {
132:     ctx.beginPath();
133:     ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
134:     ctx.fill();
135:   }
136:     // planet centre
137:     // planet with radial gradient
138:     const planetGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
139:       centre.x,
140:       centre.y,
141:       orbitRadius * 0.05,
142:       centre.x,
143:       centre.y,
144:       orbitRadius * 0.2
145:     );
146:     planetGrad.addColorStop(0, '#555');
147:     planetGrad.addColorStop(1, '#111');
148:     ctx.fillStyle = planetGrad;
149:     ctx.beginPath();
150:     ctx.arc(centre.x, centre.y, orbitRadius * 0.2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
151:     ctx.fill();
152:     // orbit path
153:     ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.2)';
154:     ctx.lineWidth = 1;
155:     ctx.beginPath();
156:     ctx.arc(centre.x, centre.y, orbitRadius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
157:     ctx.stroke();
158: 
159:     // satellite with glow
160:     const satX = centre.x + Math.cos(satellite.angle) * orbitRadius;
161:     const satY = centre.y + Math.sin(satellite.angle) * orbitRadius;
162:     // glow effect
163:     ctx.shadowColor = satellite.color;
164:     ctx.shadowBlur = 12;
165:     // radial gradient for satellite
166:     const satGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(satX, satY, 0, satX, satY, satellite.radius);
167:     satGrad.addColorStop(0, satellite.color);
168:     satGrad.addColorStop(1, '#000');
169:     ctx.fillStyle = satGrad;
170:     ctx.beginPath();
171:     ctx.arc(satX, satY, satellite.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
172:     ctx.fill();
173:     // reset shadow
174:     ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
175: 
176:     // debris with gradient and slight glow
177:     for (const d of debris) {
178:       const x = centre.x + Math.cos(d.angle) * d.distance;
179:       const y = centre.y + Math.sin(d.angle) * d.distance;
180:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(x, y, 0, x, y, debrisConfig.radius);
181:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#ffaaaa');
182:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#ff5555');
183:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
184:       ctx.shadowColor = '#ff5555';
185:       ctx.shadowBlur = 6;
186:       ctx.beginPath();
187:       ctx.arc(x, y, debrisConfig.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
188:       ctx.fill();
189:     }
190:     ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
191: 
192:     // UI – score
193:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
194:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
195:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${Math.floor(score)}`, 10, 20);
196:     if (!running) {
197:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
198:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
199:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
200:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
201:       ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
202:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2 - 20);
203:       ctx.font = '18px sans-serif';
204:       ctx.fillText(`Final Score: ${Math.floor(score)}`, canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2 + 20);
205:     }
206:   }
207: 
208:   function loop(timestamp) {
209:     if (!startTime) startTime = timestamp;
210:     const delta = timestamp - (lastTimestamp || timestamp);
211:     lastTimestamp = timestamp;
212:     if (running) {
213:       score = (timestamp - startTime) / 1000; // seconds
214:       spawnDebris(timestamp);
215:       update(delta);
216:     }
217:     draw();
218:     if (running) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
219:   }
220:   let lastTimestamp = null;
221:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
222: })();
